what: Kinross Gold mines gold in the United States, Canada, Brazil, Chile and Mauritania. Its largest operations are Tasiast in Mauritania and Paracatu in Brazil, plus Nevada and Alaska assets.
moat: Long-life mines with improving costs, concentrated enough that operational gains at one or two assets move the whole company.
risks: Mauritanian operations carry political and tax risk
It sold its Russian assets at a loss in 2022, a reminder of jurisdiction risk
A low dividend yield of under 1%
opportunities: Revenue grew about 37% last year and about 27% a year over three years
Operating margin of 46% and return on invested capital of 27%
Analysts see large upside, with a median target well above the current price
watch: All-in sustaining cost per ounce and production at Tasiast and Paracatu.
